name: asl-markets-web
description: Fan-made, play-money prediction market and stats site for the ASL (StarCraft: Brood War)

scripts.stats:export: python scripts/liquipedia/parse_seasons.py --quiet && python scripts/export-stats/export_stats.py data/source data/generated
scripts.stats:test: python -m unittest discover -s scripts/liquipedia/tests -v && python -m unittest discover -s scripts/export-stats/tests -v
scripts.stats:fetch: python scripts/liquipedia/fetch_seasons.py && python scripts/liquipedia/parse_seasons.py --quiet && python scripts/liquipedia/fetch_players.py && python scripts/liquipedia/parse_seasons.py --quiet
